# Image smoke fixtures

Three labelled potato-leaf examples from
https://github.com/spMohanty/PlantVillage-Dataset/tree/master/raw/color
(`Potato___Early_blight`, `Potato___Late_blight`, `Potato___healthy`).

Used only to check input preprocessing, class order, local model inference and API
integration. They are from the model's declared training dataset: passing these tests
does **not** measure independent accuracy or reliability on field photographs.
See the source repository for dataset attribution and terms.
